Bundled PDF report renderer

dompdf/dompdf 3.1.6 — https://github.com/dompdf/dompdf
Dependencies and exact upstream references are listed in composer.lock.
Original source and licenses for all packages are included under vendor/.
This distribution retains the LGPL/MIT/BSD notices supplied by the packages.

Installed without development packages, plugins or install scripts.
Report generation uses local bundled fonts, with remote resources, inline PHP
and PDF JavaScript disabled. No shell command or external PDF service is used.
